name: Kimi K3
description: The world's first open 3T-class model from Moonshot AI, featuring a 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture. Designed specifically for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and deep reasoning with a 1M-token context window. Positioned as the largest open-weight model ever released, rivaling top U.S. systems like OpenAI and Anthropic.
community_quotes: Designed for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning
1M-token context window with native vision capabilities

name: Clark
description: An AI agent with its own private cloud computer that can browse the web, run code, manage files, and return finished artifacts. Unlike typical AI assistants that only provide advice, Clark has a dedicated browser, terminal, and file system, enabling it to execute real development tasks independently.
community_quotes: An AI coworker with its own cloud computer
Can browse, run code, manage files, and return finished artifacts
Instead of stopping at advice, it can execute real work

name: Unabyss for Claude
description: A shared memory layer and workspace memory tool for Claude that creates unified context across all applications and LLMs. Pulls context from 20+ apps including email, Google Drive, GitHub, Notion, and meeting recorders, with bidirectional memory that reads and writes context back to applications.
community_quotes: Shared memory across all apps and LLMs. In Claude
Creates unified memory layer that works across multiple AI tools

name: ZooData
description: The data layer for AI agents that transforms any URL into agent-ready JSON, enabling AI agents to work with structured data instead of raw HTML or bloated markdown. Ranked #1 on Product Hunt for July 18, 2026 with 630 upvotes, representing infrastructure for the growing AI agent ecosystem.
community_quotes: The data layer for AI agents
Turns any URL into agent-ready JSON
#1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt (July 18, 2026)

name: OpenMarkdown
description: A fast, lightweight markdown editor designed for collaborative editing between developers and AI agents. Opens any .md file instantly and enables real-time co-editing where the AI agent can read, write, and format markdown alongside the user. Ranked #5 on Product Hunt for July 18, 2026.
community_quotes: A markdown editor you and your agent co-edit
#5 Product of the Day on Product Hunt (July 18, 2026)
The agent can read, write, and co-edit files in real-time
